bio: Exceptional ingredients from committed suppliers, staff well-being and the belief that our actions impact the lives of our peers: such are some of the topics that are regularly discussed by Grégoire Gillard and his team. In their suitably untreated, trendy street corner establishment, near the fish market, they conjure up their vision of sustainable gastronomy. The surprise menu shines the limelight on the excellent produce of Brussels and its region, with an underlying commitment to respecting the seasons, however short. Nature is what inspires chef Gillard’s creativity, although he isn’t averse to the odd exotic twist. For example, he may thinly slice oysters, then coat them in finely chopped crunchy celeriac, grated iced goat’s cheese and a stunning sorbet of wasabi and East Indian cher...
